answer: Vested payout streaming: agent earnings lock and drip out over many epochs. A fresh identity accrues rewards into a vesting pool released linearly; slash or sybil detection burns the unvested remainder. An attacker's farm of thousands collects only the first-epoch plume before abandoning each clone, so its return curve hits a nadir below per-identity cost. Persistent agents ride through the vesting lagoon and keep everything, making bulk fake identities self-defeating.
